name: Sonic Robo Blast 2
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Sonic Robo Blast 2, the 3D Sonic fan game, as a netgame server run with Wine. Put addons in the addons folder.
startup: rm -f latest-log.txt; wine ./srb2win.exe -dedicated -port {{SERVER_PORT}} -room {{ROOM_NR}} & pid=$!; tail -n +1 -F latest-log.txt --pid=$pid 2>/dev/null; wait $pid

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Sonic Robo Blast 2. Downloads the full Windows release from GitHub (run
# with Wine; SRB2 publishes no Linux build). The game's own files are
# replaced; adedserv.cfg, config.cfg, addons and saves are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=STJr/SRB2
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

want="${SRB2_VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$want" = latest ] || want="SRB2_release_${want#SRB2_release_}"
tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want") ||
    fail "Sonic Robo Blast 2 has no release ${SRB2_VERSION}. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.2.15."
ver=${tag#SRB2_release_}
asset=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk '!f && $1 ~ /^SRB2-v[0-9]+-Full\.zip$/ { print $1; f = 1 }')
[ -n "$asset" ] || fail "Sonic Robo Blast 2 $ver has no full Windows download."

if [ "$(cat .raptor-srb2 2>/dev/null)" = "$asset" ] && [ -f srb2win.exe ]; then
    echo "Sonic Robo Blast 2 $ver is already installed."
else
    build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
    rm -rf "$build"
    mkdir -p "$build/x"
    trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
    echo "Downloading Sonic Robo Blast 2 $ver"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/srb2.zip"
    unzip -tq "$build/srb2.zip" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "The download isn't a whole zip file. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q "$build/srb2.zip" -d "$build/x"
    [ -f "$build/x/srb2win.exe" ] || fail "The download has no srb2win.exe in it."
    cp -af "$build/x/." .
    echo "$asset" > .raptor-srb2
fi

# What the dedicated server runs at start; the Panel sets these lines.
if [ ! -f adedserv.cfg ]; then
    cat > adedserv.cfg <<'CFG'
servername "Sonic Robo Blast 2"
maxplayers 16
password ""
CFG
fi
mkdir -p addons
echo "Installed Sonic Robo Blast 2 $ver."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The release to install, such as 2.2.15, or latest.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password to log in as admin from the game (login <password>).

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players at once, up to 32.

variables.name: Room
variables.description: The master server room to list the server in: 33 standard, 28 casual.

variables.name: Wine debug
variables.description: Wine's debug channels. -all keeps the console quiet.
